summary: Keep CPU cohort coverage honest and commission a separate isolated quiet reference

replay.detail: CPU minute diagnostics remain daemon-local, bounded to one closed hour; no historical replay.

schema.detail: No persisted schema, claims or generated client contract changes. The raw SLO CPU diagnostics add bounded minute_evidence.

rules.detail: The production singleton-worker CPU sampler fences the newest reported process birth before freshness/key accounting. A changed incarnation still makes its transition minute unknown, but an older still-fresh report no longer poisons the next stable minute and delayed older reports cannot revive it. Ambiguous equal births and nonexact multi-worker cohorts remain unknown. Bounded reasons retain attribution. CPU-only seat eligibility ignores same-incarnation runtime heartbeats when matching harness evidence proves the live session quiet. Starts, work, background jobs and unknown harness state remain non-idle. Production cpu keeps the full 60-minute denominator, and cpu/idle keeps its ten-minute minimum and 0.5-core limit.

compatibility.detail: CPU/idle displays not eligible: busy when productive seats alone prevent its minimum; status remains no-data with no budget credit. The read-only commission-cpu-quiet-reference command emits an explicitly separate measured ten-minute population, never production success.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout. The local CPU ledger warms for a full hour after daemon restart; unknown coverage is not rewritten.

manual.detail: Commission the quiet reference only on a representative state/network-isolated member using the same build/configuration and worker topology. Supply the isolation/launch receipt and retain command JSON output; see docs/st3/objectives.md. No live work is paused.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores prior CPU diagnostics and eligibility behavior; no persisted conversion is needed.
